claims.claim: An exactly continuous even finite-energy packet has a controlled local threshold envelope through t=O(R^2).
The frozen envelope has a nonvanishing error at t=tau R^2; the real comparison packet trace has an explicit positive O(R) time integral.
The packet quadratic source matches DT profiles with evolving envelopes and a negative-weight O(R^-3) local remainder.
Retarded cascade error with spatial tails and matching to the actual nonlinear preparation remain unproved.
